name: BACH_0005
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
The conformal set, second model and all 5 similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others <1% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 26th percentile | Typical, reliable input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive [F5] | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept-model association [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Concept-model association with invasive carcinoma [F4] · Validated
- **Nuclear size and size variation** (regions 1, 4, 8) · context · Both above 90% of reference images [F7, F8] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score high, but failed spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion effect is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable and both lean invasive here.

## Could be wrong if
- Concept scores are prompt-derived and unvalidated against the classifier; mitoses and necrosis failed spot checks.
- Reliability error AUROC is only 0.69 (CI 0.58–0.87), so high reliability is weak assurance.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 4**: confirm stromal invasion rather than in situ growth or normal lobules.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 9**: verify pleomorphism and count true mitoses yourself.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: confirm tumor at the medial edge (suggested margin call) [F11].
